1: // Minimal Asteroid Dash game
2: // Canvas with id "game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const W = (canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800);
8:   const H = (canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600);
9: 
10:   // Ship definition
11:   const ship = {
12:     x: W / 2,
13:     y: H / 2,
14:     r: 12,
15:     angle: 0,
16:     speed: 0,
17:     maxSpeed: 3,
18:     thrust: 0.1,
19:     fuel: 100,
20:     fuelDrain: 0.02,
21:   };
22: 
23:   const keys = {};
24:   addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
25:   addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
26: 
27:   // Asteroid pool
28:   const asteroids = [];
29:   function spawnAsteroid() {
30:     const radius = 15 + Math.random() * 20;
31:     const side = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'left' : 'right';
32:     const x = side === 'left' ? -radius : W + radius;
33:     const y = Math.random() * H;
34:     const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 2;
35:     const angle = side === 'left' ? 0 : Math.PI;
36:     asteroids.push({ x, y, radius, speed, angle });
37:   }
38:   let spawnTimer = 0;
39: 
40:   // Simple starfield background
41:   const stars = Array.from({ length: 100 }, () => ({
42:     x: Math.random() * W,
43:     y: Math.random() * H,
44:     r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
45:     speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2,
46:   }));
47: 
48:   function update() {
49:     // Controls
50:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.angle -= 0.05;
51:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.angle += 0.05;
52:     if (keys['ArrowUp']) {
53:       ship.speed = Math.min(ship.maxSpeed, ship.speed + ship.thrust);
54:       ship.fuel = Math.max(0, ship.fuel - 0.1);
55:     } else {
56:       ship.speed *= 0.99; // drag
57:     }
58:     ship.x += Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.speed;
59:     ship.y += Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.speed;
60:     // wrap around
61:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x += W;
62:     if (ship.x > W) ship.x -= W;
63:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y += H;
64:     if (ship.y > H) ship.y -= H;
65:     ship.fuel = Math.max(0, ship.fuel - ship.fuelDrain);
66: 
67:     // Asteroids
68:     spawnTimer -= 1;
69:     if (spawnTimer <= 0) {
70:       spawnAsteroid();
71:       spawnTimer = 60 + Math.random() * 60; // approx 1‑2 sec
72:     }
73:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
74:       const a = asteroids[i];
75:       a.x += Math.cos(a.angle) * a.speed;
76:       a.y += Math.sin(a.angle) * a.speed;
77:       // remove off‑screen
78:       if (a.x < -a.radius || a.x > W + a.radius) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
79:     }
80: 
81:     // Collision detection (circle)
82:     for (const a of asteroids) {
83:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
84:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
85:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
86:       if (dist < a.radius + ship.r) {
87:         gameOver();
88:         return;
89:       }
90:     }
91:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) { gameOver(); return; }
92:   }
93: 
94:   function draw() {
95:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
96:     // stars
97:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
98:     for (const s of stars) {
99:       s.x += s.speed;
100:       if (s.x > W) s.x = 0;
101:       ctx.beginPath();
102:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
103:       ctx.fill();
104:     }
105:     // ship
106:     ctx.save();
107:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
108:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
109:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
110:     ctx.beginPath();
111:     ctx.moveTo(ship.r, 0);
112:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.r, ship.r / 2);
113:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.r, -ship.r / 2);
114:     ctx.closePath();
115:     ctx.fill();
116:     ctx.restore();
117:     // asteroids
118:     ctx.fillStyle = '#a52a2a';
119:     for (const a of asteroids) {
120:       ctx.beginPath();
121:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
122:       ctx.fill();
123:     }
124:     // fuel gauge
125:     ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
126:     ctx.fillRect(10, 10, 104, 14);
127:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
128:     ctx.fillRect(12, 12, ship.fuel, 10);
129:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#000';
130:     ctx.strokeRect(10, 10, 104, 14);
131:   }
132: 
133:   let running = true;
134:   function gameOver() {
135:     running = false;
136:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
137:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
138:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
139:     ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
140:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
141:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2);
142:   }
143: 
144:   function loop() {
145:     if (!running) return;
146:     update();
147:     draw();
148:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
149:   }
150:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
151: })();

(End of file - total 151 lines)
</content>
